moments.title: Boardmasters Festival Wraps Up
moments.blurb: The UK's major surf and music festival, Boardmasters, concludes this weekend in Newquay, Cornwall, with its final day of music and action sports on Sunday.

angles.name: Festival Vibe
angles.copy: Sun, surf, and stellar tunes! Boardmasters is wrapping up its epic run in Newquay this weekend. Who's been down on the Cornish coast living their best festival life?

angles.name: Local Angle (Cornwall/Devon)
angles.copy: The waves are still breaking and the music's still pumping as Boardmasters draws to a close in Newquay. Our neighbours in Cornwall are having one last blast this weekend!

angles.name: FOMO/Highlights
angles.copy: If you're not at Boardmasters right now, you're missing out on the last few days of surf, skate, and sounds. What's been your highlight if you made it down?
